name: House of Jane, Inc.
summary: House of Jane, Inc. (HOJI) specializes in developing and distributing therapeutic lifestyle solutions. Their product line primarily features cannabidiol (CBD) extracts and oils, sourced from both hemp and entire plant matter. These offerings are designed to promote natural, safe healing and provide energy, supporting various aspects of well-being, including exercise performance, enhancing mental and physical focus, and improving overall psychological health. Customers can acquire their hemp-based CBD products through diverse channels, including their online platform, health stores, and other retail outlets. The company, which originated in Phoenix, Arizona in 2004, was initially known as VT Business Products, Inc. before it rebranded to House of Jane, Inc. in January 2019. Currently, HOJI operates as a subsidiary under Visitalk Capital Corporation.
